placements.why: The content concerns system robustness against a production failure pattern where a markdown heading with no id field causes a crash. This is an architectural concern about how the system should behave under edge cases, warranting a new strata category since none exists yet.
placements.title: System design must account for malformed input
placements.theme: Architecture must ensure the system degrades gracefully when encountering unexpected or malformed input in production.

placements.title: From crash to valid slug on missing-id input
placements.theme: The derive-id pipeline must produce a valid slug rather than crash when a markdown heading carries no id field.
placements.why: src-1 reproduces the production failure pattern — a ## heading with no id field — and src-2 states the directive that the system must not crash and must produce a valid slug. Together they support a narrative about graceful degradation in the slug generation pipeline: the system should handle malformed input by generating valid output, not by crashing.
